- Initial release of Generation Editor Generator skill.
- Automatically generates and edits videos from user-uploaded clips (supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Handles session setup, token authentication, and cloud video processing (1–2 minutes typical).
- Exports 1080p MP4 files; supports adding transitions, text overlays, BGM, and more.
- Provides clear user guidance for uploading, editing, previewing, checking credits, and exporting videos.
- Robust error handling for authentication, file size/type, and export limits, with helpful user feedback.
